body_markdown:
## Treat Your Pup to a Dutch Run® This National Dog Day


At Dutch Bros®, we are paws-itively obsessed with spoiling you and your four-legged friends! **Treat your pup to a Dutch Run on Wednesday, August 26 and score a free dog bandana with every medium or large drink purchase, starting at 5 a.m., while supplies last!***


Check out a few of our favorite ways to enjoy this special day with your furry friend:


Let your pup ride shotgun **** while you sip on the[Caramel Pumpkin Brûlée 🎃](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/caramel-pumpkin-br-l-e/)


Load up your pup, roll down the windows and indulge in this fall-time favorite featuring pumpkin and salted caramel, covered in a layer of Soft Top®, pumpkin drizzle and raw sugar sprinks.


Cuddle up on the couch with the[Cookie Butter 🤎](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/cookie-butter/)


Cozy up after a long day of tail wags and savor this creamy creation packed with cookie butter flavor, a cookie butter swirl around the cup, topped with Soft Top and another layer of cookie butter drizzle.


Run around in the park **** and recharge with the[Autumn Berry 🍇](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/autumn-berry/)


After a busy day of playing fetch and chasing tails, this afternoon pick-me-up is a must-have. It combines juicy pomegranate, citrusy orange, and sweet peach into a crisp, refreshing drink topped with mixed berries.


**Max 5 per customer. Order ahead does not reserve items or guarantee availability.*


Find the nearest Dutch Bros on our location page or the DB app!
